# `collab/CollabCore.js`

> **Source:** `engine/collab/CollabCore.js`

CollabCore.js WebRTC peer connection management. Manages RTCPeerConnection instances, data channels, and reconnection. Two data channels per peer: 'ops'      — reliable, ordered (scene operations) 'presence' — unreliable, unordered (camera/selection at 10Hz)

## Functions

### `createCollabCore(config)`

Create a collab core instance. config: { projectId, selfId, username, onOp, onPresence, onPeerDiscovered, shouldConnectPeer, onPeerJoin, onPeerLeave }

### `startCollab(core)`

Start signaling and begin peer discovery.

### `forceDiscovery(core)`

Force an immediate discovery pass: re-announce on all signaling tiers right now. Lets an app-layer "Connect now" find a known contact without waiting for the periodic announce cycle. Does not tear down existing peers.

### `broadcastOp(core, op)`

Broadcast an op to all connected peers. Transport priority: 1. FastChannel (same-origin BroadcastChannel) — <1ms 2. Gossip mesh (partial mesh / supernode mode) — K neighbors, O(log N) delivery 3. Full mesh WebRTC — direct to all (≤6 peers)

### `broadcastPresence(core, presenceData)`

Broadcast presence data to all connected peers (unreliable channel). Prefers fast channel for same-origin peers.

### `collabChunkEnvelopeReport(data)`

### `sendToPeer(core, peerId, data)`

Send data to a specific peer only. Prefers fast channel for same-origin peers. Auto-chunks large messages to avoid SCTP size limits.

### `relayOp(core, fromPeerId, op)`

Relay an op from one peer to all other peers (host-only, relay mode). Optionally filters by spatial interest set.

**Parameters:**

- `core` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `fromPeerId` *(string)* — peer who sent the op
- `op` *(Object)* — the op to relay

### `computeDynamicCapacity(core, peerReputation)`

Compute the dynamic peer capacity based on connection quality. Fast channel peers are free. Trusted peers expand the mesh limit.

**Parameters:**

- `core` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[peerReputation]` *(Object)* — reputation state for score lookups

**Returns:** }

### `checkRelayMode(core, peerReputation)`

Check peer count and toggle relay mode if threshold is crossed. Now uses dynamic capacity — fast peers don't count, trusted peers expand the limit.

**Parameters:**

- `core` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[peerReputation]` *(Object)* — optional reputation state

**Returns:** true if relay mode changed

### `setCoreRelayConfig(core, opts)`

Set the spatial authority reference for interest-filtered relay.

### `setCoreFastChannel(core, fastChannel)`

Set the fast channel reference on the core. Called by EditorCollab after creating the fast channel.

### `setCoreTopology(core, topology)`

Set the mesh topology reference on the core. Called by EditorCollab after creating the topology manager.

### `isPeerTrusted(core, peerId, peerScore)`

Check if a peer is trusted (high reputation) and should get a direct connection even in relay mode. Trusted peers bypass the relay host for lower latency.

**Parameters:**

- `core` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `peerId` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `peerScore` *(number)* — reputation score 0-1000

**Returns:** true if peer is trusted

**Returns:** }

### `getMaxBufferedAmount(core)`

Get the maximum bufferedAmount across all peer ops channels. Used by CollabMessageRouter for backpressure detection.

### `collabBufferedAmountReport(value)`

### `getSelfId(core)`

Get the local peer ID.

### `getPeers(core)`

Get all connected peers.

### `connectCollabPeer(core, peerId, username = 'Remote')`

Begin a targeted WebRTC connection to an already-discovered peer.

### `disconnectCollabPeer(core, peerId)`

Close one direct peer connection without tearing down discovery.

### `async observeCollabPeerMetrics(core, peerId)`

Collect locally observed transport quality. Remote peers cannot supply or inflate these values, which makes them suitable input for topology roles.

### `destroyCollabCore(core)`

Destroy all connections and signaling.

### `async deriveCollabChannelId(selfId, peerId)`

Derive a shared AES-256-GCM key from ECDH key exchange. Called after hello handshake when both peers have ECDH public keys.

### `collabReconnectPlanReport(attempts)`

### `collabHeartbeatReport(lastPongMs, timestampMs)`

### `broadcastGoodbye(core)`

Broadcast a graceful goodbye to all peers before leaving. This lets other peers immediately remove us instead of waiting for heartbeat timeout or WebRTC state change.
